summary: A holdout lets a bill out of committee while reserving a demand for changes before the floor vote.
realLife: Josh Brecheen switched to present in committee after talks on tax credits and work rules, although the text still lacked the changes he sought.
inGame: needs: a committee vote of present linked to a later floor amendment and vote.

turns.what: The holdout votes against reporting the bill.
turns.pulledBy: The sponsor refuses to reopen the disputed section before the floor vote.

turns.what: The holdout gives the sponsor a yes on the floor after the amendment passes.
turns.pulledBy: The adopted text now contains the requested change.
turns.writesBack: The floor roll records support after the earlier reservation.
